title: Three Shifts and One Short Rope
subtitle: 品格修养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）
meta: 主题语境：品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）　|　核心词汇：reputation　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 reputation 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 the foreman ① earned the reputation that no worker in the site would have measured, and he said the earning was the whole of the shift. The ② reputation, meaning the name itself and not the rope, ran three shifts and stayed unmeasured in the book; a reputation, he said, is the only thing in a site that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ reputation in that site had the same short rope beside it, and the ④ reputation at the far ramp, meaning the load they kept for the children to lift and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A reputation, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the foreman said the measuring is the part that fills three shifts.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the reputation was the whole of the matter, meaning the honour and not the name. The ⑥ reputation, meaning the honour and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; reputation, he said, is either something you earn or the only word that means both a name and an honour. He said the honour is the part they remember.

By 1966 the ⑦ reputation had become a line in a sheet, and the sheet had become an argument about the short rope. The ⑧ reputation of the whole thing, the foreman wrote in May, was one site and three shifts of measuring; reputation, he said, is either the load at the far ramp or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ reputation I remember is the name measured in the sheet, which closed in 1968 and is still measured as the quietest in the site. A ⑩ reputation, my mother said in 1970, is the only name that improves by being measured; every reputation, she said, is an honour that has agreed to look like a name. She said the honour was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 名声；声誉（指工地里每一份旁边的那一份）
B. n. 名声；声誉（指那份名声本身，与短短的绳索相对）
C. 固定搭配：earn the reputation 挣得这一份名声
D. n. 名声；声誉（指留给孩子们抬的那一车）
E. n. 名声之事（抽象总称，指一处工地的名声之事）
F. n. 名声；声誉（指施工单里写到、被测量的那一份）
G. n. 名声、体面（指一件事里人人都干却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 体面（抽象总称，指人人都干却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: earned the reputation that no worker in the site would have measured
The reputation, meaning the name itself and not the rope
the reputation at the far ramp
the reputation was the whole of the matter
the reputation had become a line in a sheet
The reputation of the whole thing
A reputation, my mother said in 1970

answers.why: earn the reputation 意为“挣得这一份名声”，1961 年那位工头把工地里没有一位工人肯测量的一份名声做了一遍。
reputation 意为“名声；声誉”，指那份名声本身而不是短短的绳索，它经过了三个班次而在簿子上没有被测量。
reputation 意为“名声；声誉”，指工地里每一份旁边的那一份，每一份旁边都有同一根短短的绳索。
reputation 意为“名声；声誉”，指最远那道坡台的留给孩子们抬的那一车，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
reputation 意为“名声、体面”，指一件事里人人都干却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份体面就是那件事的全部。
reputation 意为“体面”，指人人都干却无人提起的那样东西而不是那份名声，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
reputation 意为“名声；声誉”，指施工单里写到、被测量的那一份，到 1966 年这一份成了施工单里的一行。
reputation 意为“名声之事”，工头五月写道，整件事的名声之事是一处工地和三个班次的测量。
reputation 意为“名声；声誉”，我记得的是施工单里测量过的那一份，1968 年收工了，至今仍被说成工地里最安静的一份。
reputation 为抽象总称，母亲 1970 年说，名声是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的名声。
